title: Grateful Dead Live at Carousel Ballroom on 1968-03-30

ai_review.summary: Muffled but airy soundboard capture of an intense early‑68 set highlighted by a scorching The Other One > Dark Star sequence and rare Born Cross‑Eyed/Spanish Jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its hot jamming – especially The Other One into Dark Star, a sparkling China Cat, and the seldom‑heard Born Cross‑Eyed > Spanish Jam combo. Recording-wise it’s an SBD (soundboard) source that sounds distant and a bit muffled, with Pigpen’s organ noticeably muted, but listeners still find the airy quality enjoyable for a 1968 tape.

ai_rating.rationale: All three detailed reviews are positive (4‑5 stars) and focus on strong musical moments; recording is described as good despite muffling, leading to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Muffled and distant sound giving an airy feel; Pigpen's keyboard largely muted; no major dropouts noted.

poor_songs: Feedback transition to Spanish Jam (not smooth)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Overall hot jamming with several rare combos; a few transitions feel uneven but the set maintains strong energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His soloing is notably different from ’66 style, intense on The Other One and Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is muted, reducing the characteristic 1968 keyboard presence.
